devices.title: Select devices
devices.description: Include imports only the checked devices. Exclude imports every device except the checked ones, including devices added to the account later. An empty Include list imports nothing; an empty Exclude list imports everything.

entities.title: Select entities
entities.description: Choose individual functions for the selected devices. Include imports only checked entities; Exclude imports all except checked entities. Empty Include means none; empty Exclude means all. Saved choices absent from the current device list are shown by ID. Unselected existing entities are disabled, preserving their IDs and customizations.
